create.name: Bia de Castro Oliveira
create.bio:
Bia de Castro Oliveira is a São Paulo teacher of Quantum-Touch, known in Brazil as Toque Quântico, and a reader of tarot, astrology and numerology. Trained as an educator, she began studying esoteric subjects in her early teens under a mentor who introduced her to Theosophy, Spiritism, the Kabbalah and the symbolic arts. In the 1990s she lived in California, where she trained in several energy and tapping methods, and after returning to Brazil she became one of the first Quantum-Touch instructors there. She serves as the method's Portuguese-language liaison, is accredited to teach several of its levels and trains new Level 1 instructors, and is also a Reiki and Seichim master.

She runs the Quantum-Touch workshop series in São Paulo, from the two-day Becoming Energized course, which teaches breathing and body-awareness techniques for focusing life-force energy, through the advanced levels, holding them at a holistic centre in the city. Alongside this she gives private consultations: tarot used as a tool for self-knowledge rather than fortune-telling, natal astrology charts with solar returns and transits, and numerology readings, in person in São Paulo or online by video call. She works in Portuguese and English and has explained Toque Quântico on Brazilian television and radio.

courses.title: Quantum-Touch Nível 1: Tornando-se Energizado (Becoming Energized)
courses.description: Bia's two-day foundation workshop in São Paulo, taught in Portuguese. Students learn to combine breathing and body awareness to focus and amplify life-force energy, the base for all later Quantum-Touch levels.

courses.title: Consulta de Tarot (Leitura do Inconsciente)
courses.description: A tarot consultation of about an hour and a quarter, approached as a way into the unconscious for self-knowledge and clearer decisions rather than prediction. In person in São Paulo or online by video call.

courses.title: Consulta de Astrologia (Mapa Astrológico)
courses.description: A recorded reading of about ninety minutes covering the natal chart, the solar return for the year ahead and current planetary transits.

courses.title: Consulta de Numerologia
courses.description: A numerology reading of the birth chart, the personal year ahead and daily vibration, offered in person or online.
